## 1. 各分部详细分析

### 1.1 Productivity and Business Processes（生产力与商业流程）

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 收入 | 37,847 | 33,112 | **+14.3%**（报道口径）/ +14%（口径提示中 constant currency 表） |
| 营业成本 | 6,989 | 6,042 | +15.7% |
| 毛利润 | 30,858 | 27,070 | +14.0% |
| 经营费用 | 8,958 | 8,077 | +10.9% |
| 经营利润 | 21,900 | 18,993 | **+15.3%** |
| 经营利润率 | 57.9% | 57.4% | +0.5pp |

> 收入/成本/经营费用/经营利润数据出处：`financial_statements.txt` → "Segment Results" → Productivity and Business Processes 行。
> 经营利润率 57.9% = 21,900 / 37,847（本表自行计算）。

**增长驱动因素（引用原文）**：

1. **Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud**：`press_release.txt` 第 15 行 — "Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% when adjusted for the prior year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. On a reported basis, Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 14%." 电话会 `transcript.txt` Amy Hood 段落："M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. And on a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%."

2. **M365 Commercial products**：`transcript.txt` Amy Hood 段落 — "M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."

3. **M365 Consumer cloud**：`press_release.txt` 第 15 行 — "Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue increased 24% (up 22% in constant currency)." 电话会 — "M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth."

4. **LinkedIn**：`press_release.txt` 第 15 行 — "LinkedIn revenue increased 12% (up 10% in constant currency)." 电话会 — "LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."

5. **Dynamics 365**：`press_release.txt` 第 15 行 — "Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% (up 12% in constant currency)." 电话会 — "Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles."

**分部整体评述**：本分部增长稳健（+14%），由 M365 Commercial 与 Consumer 双引擎驱动，LinkedIn 与 Dynamics 365 表现中规中矩。经营利润率 57.9% 同比提升 0.5pp，反映 ARPU 提升与 E5/E7 高级 SKU 渗透带来的盈利改善。但需注意 M365 Commercial products 的高增长部分来自"Windows Commercial on-premises component"的一次性确认节奏（prior-year comparable 已受益于 2 点 in-period 确认），需避免过度线性外推。

---

### 1.2 Intelligent Cloud（智能云）

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 收入 | 39,306 | 29,878 | **+31.6%**（报道口径）/ +31%（constant currency） |
| 营业成本 | 16,876 | 11,845 | +42.5% |
| 毛利润 | 22,430 | 18,033 | +24.4% |
| 经营费用 | 6,475 | 5,893 | +9.9% |
| 经营利润 | 15,955 | 12,140 | **+31.4%** |
| 经营利润率 | 40.6% | 40.6% | 持平 |

> 数据出处：`financial_statements.txt` → "Segment Results" → Intelligent Cloud 行。经营利润率 = 15,955 / 39,306 = 40.6%。

**增长驱动因素（引用原文）**：

1. **Azure**：`press_release.txt` 第 17 行 — "Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 43%." 电话会 `transcript.txt` Amy Hood 段落 — "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

2. **On-premises server**：`transcript.txt` Amy Hood 段落 — "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

**分部整体评述**：Intelligent Cloud 本季度增速最快（+32%），Azure 43% 的强劲增长再次验证云需求持续超出供给。经营利润率 40.6% 与上年持平，尽管毛利率同比下滑（57.1% vs. 60.4%，因销售结构向 Azure 倾斜 + AI 基础设施投入），但经营费用仅 +9.9%（受共享 R&D 影响），经营利润增长与收入增长同步（+31%）。Satya Nadella 在电话会提到："We added 31 new datacenters across 5 continents this quarter, bringing the total to 88 this year"（`transcript.txt` 开场陈述），显示基础设施扩张正在加速转化为收入。

**毛利率下滑的原文解释**（`transcript.txt` Amy Hood）："Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."

---

### 1.3 More Personal Computing（更多个人计算）

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 收入 | 12,854 | 13,451 | **-4.4%**（报道口径）/ -5%（constant currency） |
| 营业成本 | 5,660 | 6,127 | -7.6% |
| 毛利润 | 7,194 | 7,324 | -1.8% |
| 经营费用 | 4,446 | 4,134 | +7.5% |
| 经营利润 | 2,748 | 3,190 | **-13.9%** |
| 经营利润率 | 21.4% | 23.7% | -2.3pp |

> 数据出处：`financial_statements.txt` → "Segment Results" → More Personal Computing 行。经营利润率 = 2,748 / 12,854 = 21.4%。

**下滑驱动因素（引用原文）**：

1. **Windows OEM and Devices**：`press_release.txt` 第 18 行 — "Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7%." 电话会 Amy Hood 段落 — "Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support. Results were ahead of expectations as OEM and channel partners continued to build inventory given increasing component prices."

2. **XBOX content and services**：`press_release.txt` 第 18 行 — "XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10%." 电话会 Amy Hood 段落 — "XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance." Satya Nadella 在电话会中明确："When it comes to XBOX, we are making the necessary decisions required across our content portfolio, platform, and operations to reset the business for long-term growth... we can bring these strengths together and expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027."（`transcript.txt` 末段）

3. **Search advertising**：`press_release.txt` 第 18 行 — "Search advertising revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs increased 10% (up 9% in constant currency)." 电话会 Amy Hood 段落 — "Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."

**分部整体评述**：More Personal Computing 是唯一收入下滑的分部（-4%），主要受 Windows OEM 与 XBOX 双重拖累。经营利润率下降 2.3pp 至 21.4%，原因有二：(1) 营业成本虽同比下滑（-7.6%，受益于 Activision 并表摊销下降），但经营费用因"shared R&D investments"以及 XBOX 减值费用（`press_release.txt` 提到 "impairment charges in XBOX"，见第 2 行 discrete items 段）而上升 +7.5%。电话会 Amy Hood 提到："Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX."（`transcript.txt` 20,000–30,000 字符区间）

## 4. 口径提示（读者注意事项）

1. **分部口径与合并口径的区别**：
   - 三个分部的"经营费用"（Operating expenses）仅包含该分部专属的 R&D、Sales & Marketing、G&A 分摊，**不包括共享的公司层面成本中心**（如整体 R&D 基础设施投入）。三个分部经营费用之和（19,879）恰好等于 Total 经营费用（19,879），说明本季度披露层级已将共享费用全部分配至各分部。
   - 经营利润率在不同分部间**不可直接比较**，因为各分部业务模式、毛利率结构、费用形态差异极大（例如 Productivity & Business Processes 毛利率 81.5% vs. More Personal Computing 56.0%）。

2. **增长口径差异**：
   - 报告披露提供 GAAP 同比与 constant currency 同比（剔除汇率影响）。例如 More Personal Computing 收入 GAAP -4.4%，constant currency -5%，说明本季度美元相对弱化，对 MPC 分部收入有 +0.6pp 的正向汇率贡献。
   - Intelligent Cloud 报告披露 +32%（press_release.txt 第 17 行），按 `financial_statements.txt` 精确计算为 +31.6%，四舍五入后一致。

3. **OpenAI 投资调整**：
   - 全公司层面存在 OpenAI 投资影响（Q4 净收益 $480M，对应 EPS 影响 $0.07），但分部数据**未单独披露 OpenAI 调整项**，分部层面的同比变化基于 GAAP 数字。如需非 GAAP 视角，应以全公司净调整为准。
   - `press_release.txt` 第 2 行："Non-GAAP results exclude the impact from investments in OpenAI."

4. **跨分部不可直接相加的指标**：
   - 各分部的"毛利率"因业务性质差异巨大（产品型分部如 Productivity 毛利率 81.5% vs. Cloud 型 Intelligent Cloud 57.1% vs. 设备型 MPC 56.0%），**不应跨分部比较毛利率绝对值**。
   - 经营利润绝对值可跨分部比较（均按 GAAP 口径），但需注意各分部规模差异（MPC 收入仅占 14.3%，其经营利润 2,748M 小于 P&BP 的 21,900M 主要源于收入规模差异）。

5. **季度内一次性事项**：
   - 本季度存在若干 discrete items：$3.2B Anthropic 投资收益、Voluntary Retirement Program 低于预期支出、XBOX 减值与遣散费（`press_release.txt` 第 2 行）。这些影响公司层面 EPS 口径（GAAP vs. non-GAAP 差异），但**未单独披露对各分部经营利润的具体影响**。XBOX 减值在 MPC 分部，因此 MPC 经营利润同比 -13.9% 可能部分受其拖累。
   - M365 Commercial cloud 16% 增长已"adjusted"剔除上一年 2 点 in-period 收入确认的影响（`transcript.txt`），但 press_release 中报告口径仍是 14%，使用者需注意区分。

6. **分部收入构成披露粒度**：
   - Productivity & Business Processes 下含 M365 Commercial、M365 Consumer、LinkedIn、Dynamics 365 四个子项，但**未单独披露各子项的成本与经营利润**，分部经营利润率仅反映整体。
   - More Personal Computing 下含 Windows OEM & Devices、XBOX content & services、Search advertising ex-TAC 三个子项，**同样未披露子项成本结构**。

---

**结语**：FY26 Q4 是微软创纪录的收官季，三个分部中两个实现高增长（Productivity & Business Processes +14%、Intelligent Cloud +32%），仅 More Personal Computing 因 Windows 与 XBOX 高基数效应下滑 4%。全公司收入 $90B、经营利润 $40.6B 均同比增长约 18%，验证了"以 AI 为核心的多云战略"正在转化为可量化的财务成果。下季度（FY27 Q1）指引收入 89.85–90.95B、增长 16–17%，Azure 增速指引 mid-40s% constant currency（`transcript.txt` Amy Hood 展望段），全年云业务有望突破 $214B（Satya Nadella 电话会开场陈述）。

> - 关键 KPI 季度趋势 → `metrics.txt`（完整季度序列）
> - 勾稽验证 → 自行基于 `financial_statements.txt` 计算，三个分部之和与 Total 完全一致（差异均为 0）
